flags: THIRD-PARTY CERT CLAIM GAP: Nudge Security profile claims SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI, FedRamp, and CSA STAR certifications, but none are mentioned on Compose AI's official website. These cannot be verified from vendor-domain sources.

NO GDPR LANGUAGE: Privacy policy addresses only US privacy laws (CCPA, Nevada). No mention of GDPR, EU data protection, Data Processing Agreements, or Standard Contractual Clauses—despite international user base.

AI TRAINING OPACITY: Privacy policy does not disclose whether user-submitted text trains the AI model. Homepage claims personalization 'learns your voice,' implying some form of model training, but no opt-out mechanism is documented.
NO DPA: No public Data Processing Agreement or vendor Data Protection Addendum available; essential for EU customers.
SINGLE JURISDICTION: Company operates under US law only; no regional compliance posture for international markets.
FUNDING PLATEAU: Seed-stage funding ($2.22M, 2021); no Series A or later rounds in 5 years suggests capital constraints for compliance/security investments.
